mapper.select: SELECT s.spending_id AS spendingId, s.merchant_name AS merchantName, s.category AS category, s.amount AS amount, s.spent_at AS spentAt, r.review_type AS reviewType FROM spending s LEFT JOIN spending_review r ON r.spending_id = s.spending_id AND r.del_yn = 'N' WHERE s.user_id = #{userId} AND s.del_yn = 'N' ORDER BY s.spent_at DESC
SELECT review_id, spending_id, review_type, reviewed_at FROM spending_review WHERE spending_id = #{spendingId} AND del_yn = 'N'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO spending_review (spending_id, review_type, reviewed_at, created_date, created_nm, del_yn) VALUES (#{spendingId}, #{reviewType}, NOW(), NOW(), #{createdNm}, 'N')
mapper.update: UPDATE spending_review SET review_type = #{reviewType}, reviewed_at = NOW(), modified_date = NOW(), modified_nm = #{modifiedNm} WHERE spending_id = #{spendingId} AND del_yn = 'N'
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(s.amount), 0) AS totalSpending, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.review_type = 'REGRET' THEN s.amount END), 0) AS regretAmount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.review_type = 'SOSO' THEN s.amount END), 0) AS sosoAmount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.review_type = 'SATISFIED' THEN s.amount END), 0) AS satisfiedAmount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.review_type = 'REGRET' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS regretCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.review_type = 'SOSO' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS sosoCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.review_type = 'SATISFIED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS satisfiedCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.review_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS untaggedCount FROM spending s LEFT JOIN spending_review r ON r.spending_id = s.spending_id AND r.del_yn = 'N' WHERE s.user_id = #{userId} AND DATE_FORMAT(s.spent_at, '%Y%m') = #{yearMonth} AND s.del_yn = 'N'

SELECT s.category AS category, SUM(s.amount) AS amount, COUNT(*) AS count FROM spending s JOIN spending_review r ON r.spending_id = s.spending_id AND r.del_yn = 'N' WHERE s.user_id = #{userId} AND r.review_type = 'REGRET' AND DATE_FORMAT(s.spent_at, '%Y%m') = #{yearMonth} AND s.del_yn = 'N' GROUP BY s.category ORDER BY amount DESC

SELECT ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(s.amount), 0) / #{months}) AS avgMonthlySpending, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.review_type = 'REGRET' THEN s.amount END), 0) / #{months}) AS avgRegretSpending FROM spending s LEFT JOIN spending_review r ON r.spending_id = s.spending_id AND r.del_yn = 'N' WHERE s.user_id = #{userId} AND s.spent_at >= DATE_SUB(DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m-01'), INTERVAL #{months} - 1 MONTH) AND s.del_yn = 'N'
